# Photosynthesis Knowledge as (Subject, Predicate, Object) Triples

## Basic Definition
- (Photosynthesis, is, biological process)
- (Photosynthesis, converts, light energy)
- (Light energy, into, chemical energy)
- (Chemical energy, stored in, glucose)

## Organisms
- (Plants, perform, photosynthesis)
- (Algae, perform, photosynthesis)
- (Cyanobacteria, perform, photosynthesis)
- (These organisms, called, autotrophs)
- (These organisms, called, producers)

## Location
- (Photosynthesis, occurs in, chloroplasts)
- (Chloroplasts, found in, plant cells)
- (Chloroplasts, contain, chlorophyll)
- (Chlorophyll, is, green pigment)
- (Chlorophyll, absorbs, light energy)

## Reactants
- (Photosynthesis, requires, carbon dioxide)
- (Photosynthesis, requires, water)
- (Photosynthesis, requires, light energy)
- (Plants, absorb, carbon dioxide)
- (Carbon dioxide, enters through, stomata)
- (Plants, absorb, water)
- (Water, absorbed through, roots)

## Products
- (Photosynthesis, produces, glucose)
- (Photosynthesis, produces, oxygen)
- (Oxygen, released through, stomata)
- (Oxygen, released into, atmosphere)

## Chemical Equation
- (Overall equation, is, 6CO2 + 6H2O + light energy → C6H12O6 + 6O2)

## Light-Dependent Reactions
- (Light-dependent reactions, occur in, thylakoid membranes)
- (Light-dependent reactions, require, light)
- (Light-dependent reactions, produce, ATP)
- (Light-dependent reactions, produce, NADPH)
- (Light-dependent reactions, produce, oxygen)
- (Water, split during, light-dependent reactions)
- (This process, called, photolysis)
- (Photosystem II, absorbs, light)
- (Photosystem I, absorbs, light)
- (Electron transport chain, connects, photosystems)

## Light-Independent Reactions (Calvin Cycle)
- (Light-independent reactions, occur in, stroma)
- (Light-independent reactions, also called, Calvin cycle)
- (Calvin cycle, does not require, light directly)
- (Calvin cycle, uses, ATP)
- (Calvin cycle, uses, NADPH)
- (Calvin cycle, fixes, carbon dioxide)
- (Calvin cycle, produces, glucose)
- (RuBisCO, is, key enzyme)
- (RuBisCO, catalyzes, carbon fixation)

## Factors Affecting Photosynthesis
- (Light intensity, affects, photosynthesis rate)
- (Carbon dioxide concentration, affects, photosynthesis rate)
- (Temperature, affects, photosynthesis rate)
- (Water availability, affects, photosynthesis rate)

## Importance
- (Photosynthesis, provides, oxygen)
- (Photosynthesis, provides, food)
- (Photosynthesis, supports, food chains)
- (Photosynthesis, removes, carbon dioxide)
- (Photosynthesis, essential for, life on Earth)
